event_summary: A rotating pointed stick attached to a black circular object contacts the purple upright block, and the row of colored blocks tips over in sequence.
raw_event_description: Six colored rectangular blocks stand upright in a row on a wooden tabletop, with a black circular object and a tan pointed stick to their right. The stick rotates from the right side toward the blocks. After approaching the purple block at the right end of the row, the stick contacts it, the purple block tilts left, and the neighboring blocks tip leftward one after another until the row is lying or leaning on the tabletop.

reasons: six upright colored blocks are visible in a row
black circular object and tan pointed stick are visible to the right
no block has begun tipping in the first frame
